name: etaori
label: eta Ori Aa (B1 V; Aa+Ab eclipsing, 7.99 d)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-10-08) and the papers it cites: V 3.42, B1 V + B3 V eclipsing pair (7.99 d) + Ac (9.4 yr) + B, T_eff 26600 K, R 6.477 Rsun, M 10.87 Msun, d 300 pc
notes: No interferometric diameter exists: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.201 mas from the quoted radius and distance; the Pathfinder would be its first measurement.
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
V 3.42 is the whole system (Aa, Ab, Ac, B); the Aa component carries roughly half of it, so the rates here are ~2x optimistic: flag.
Aa-Ab is an eclipsing 7.99 d pair with components ~0.2 and 0.15 mas: a fringe test at 300-530 m once the components are modelled as a binary.

summary.components: B1 V + B3 V eclipsing pair (7.99 d) + Ac (9.4 yr) + B
